subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 3: Let’s practise – A planet fact file
outcomes: Read a fact file about Mars and decide true or false.
Write questions about a planet: How big …? How far …? How many …?
Make and present a planet fact file.

tf.s: Mars is the smallest planet in the solar system.
tf.why: Mars is the smallest after Mercury.

tf.s: Mars has more moons than Earth.
tf.why: Mars has two moons; Earth has one.

tf.s: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun.
A fact file can have the name, size, distance from the Sun, number of moons and a fun fact.
tf.why: These are the parts of a fact file.

tf.s: "How far is it from the Sun?" is a question about distance.
"How many moons has it got?" asks about the size of a planet.
tf.why: It asks about the number of moons. How big …? asks about size.
Mars is the smallest after Mercury, so Mercury is smaller.

tf.s: Pictures and colours can make a fact file more interesting.

boxes.q: Which planet is fourth from the Sun?
How many moons has Mars got?

o: How far is it from the Sun?
How many moons has it got?
How many moons has it got?

boxes.q: How many moons has Earth got?

boxes.why: Mercury is the smallest; Mars comes after it.

boxes.q: What is a "fun fact" in a fact file?
o: an interesting thing about the planet
boxes.why: A fun fact is interesting information.

boxes.q: Complete: How ______ moons has it got?

hunt.q: Interesting fact in a fact file

mcq.q: Which planet is the smallest after Mercury?
mcq.why: Mars is the smallest after Mercury.

mcq.q: Which parts are in a planet fact file?
o: name, size, distance from the Sun, number of moons, fun fact
mcq.why: These are the parts of a fact file.

mcq.q: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
mcq.why: Mercury is first from the Sun.

mcq.q: Which planet has a big ring?
Write a question for your fact file about distance.
o: How far is it from the Sun?
How many moons has it got?

mcq.q: Write a correct question about moons.
o: How many moons has it got?
How much moons has it got?
How far moons has it got?
mcq.why: How many + plural noun + has it got?

mcq.q: Choose two correct facts for a Jupiter fact file.
o: Jupiter is the biggest planet. It has more than 90 moons.
Jupiter is the smallest planet. It has no moons.
Jupiter is the closest to the Sun. It is red.
Jupiter is our planet. It has one moon.
mcq.why: Jupiter is the biggest and has many moons.

mcq.q: "Mars has more moons than Earth." Why is this true?
o: Mars has two moons and Earth has one.
Mars has one moon and Earth has two.

mcq.q: "Mars is the smallest planet." Why is this false?
mcq.why: Mars is the smallest after Mercury.

mcq.q: Why do we add pictures and colours to a fact file?
o: To make it difficult to read.
mcq.why: Pictures and colours help people enjoy and understand it.
